new_page.title: Businesses for Sale in Langley
new_page.description: Businesses for sale in Langley on the MLS®, with or without the real estate, plus what to ask for before you buy a business.

faq_heading: Businesses for Sale in Langley: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Businesses for sale in Langley, with or without the real estate, listed on the MLS®. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: Township of Langley licences cannot be transferred: a new owner must apply for a new licence, and new or relocating businesses should allow at least 30 business days. ([Township of Langley, business licences](https://www.tol.ca/en/services/business-licences.aspx), read November 20, 2026)

Every business operating in the City of Langley needs a valid City licence before it starts. ([City of Langley, business licences](https://www.langleycity.ca/business-development/permits-licensing/business-licences), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: What to ask for before you buy a business

items.t: Business only or with the property: many MLS® business listings sell the business and its lease, not the building. The listing says which.
The lease: its remaining term, renewal options and whether the landlord must approve an assignment to you.
The numbers: at least two or three years of financial statements and tax returns, and what is included (equipment, stock, name, website, phone number).
Licences and permits: the municipal business licence and any provincial licence the business needs, and whether they transfer.
Staff and suppliers: who stays, and which contracts carry over.
